records.title: Cambridge Trust International Scholarship
records.official_source: The Cambridge Trust (Cambridge Commonwealth, European & International Trust)
records.deadline_display: No separate scholarship application exists. The University of Cambridge admission application must be submitted by the funding deadline specific to your course, which is different from the application deadline and is listed in the Postgraduate Course Directory. The funding section of the application must be completed to be considered for funding.
records.application_period: The Trust's awarding period runs from the middle of February to the end of July each year, with most awards made in February and March and unclaimed awards reallocated during the period. Applicants remain under consideration until the end of July.

records.title: NYCU Elite Ph.D. Scholarship for New Students
records.official_source: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU), Office of International Affairs, Division of International Talent Cultivation
records.deadline_display: No application deadline exists for this award. NYCU states that the Elite Ph.D. Scholarship "is awarded based on recommendations from the college and a review by the scholarship committee, not through the application submitted by the students". The only recurring dates are the per-semester deadline by which existing recipients must submit transcripts and tuition payment receipts to stay eligible the following semester.
records.application_period: Not student-applied. New Ph.D. places are nominated by the candidate's college and reviewed by the scholarship committee within NYCU's doctoral admission cycle. Existing recipients must submit transcripts and tuition payment receipts each semester before a per-semester deadline to remain eligible in the following semester, and renewals are handled in the application period announced by the OIA.
